items.title: Nessel Appeals Fast-Track DTE Deals for 1.4-Gigawatt Washtenaw Data Center
items.dek: The attorney general wants the contracts with Green Chile Ventures sent back for a full hearing, citing hidden costs and the risk of higher electric bills for Michigan customers.
